summary: Mara Ellery, a verified customer on the secure portal, asked why her 14 July 2025 transfer to Northmere Housing Co-operative was not completed. The desk read her request as a payment question and put the case in WAITING for the payment system's answer, which had not come in, so no reason was given to her. The agent's later attempts to ask the payment system again and to escalate to a person were both refused because the case was no longer in the TRIAGED state, so nothing has been sent on and a person will need to pick the case up.

content.text:
I couldn't find out why the transfer wasn't completed, and the case is now waiting.

- **Payment lookup:** I asked the payment system about the 14 July 2025 transfer to Northmere Housing Co-operative. The desk refused the request because the case is in the WAITING state, and the lookup only runs when it is TRIAGED.
